messages:
mike_sourcing: Heads up — vendor (NexaSupply) just pushed the H200 replenishment ETA back by ~7 days. Customs flagged a missing commercial invoice. This will affect EU-edge pool reservations for next-week backfill. Need quick decision on expedite vs reallocate.

anna_logistics: Copying vendor note: 
`AWB: AWB123456789`
'Carrier: GlobalAir. Shipment on hold pending commercial invoice clarification. Earliest release +7d.'

josh_infra: If EU-west misses that backfill, we expect a ~12% latency increase on short-tail requests during peak. Can we borrow capacity from US-west for 9 days? Any networking gotchas?

elaine_ops: Borrowing cross-region will add egress costs and increase cold-starts for stateful caches. Ballpark +$3k/day and a small SLA risk on cache warmup.

mike_sourcing: Vendor offered an air-expedite for a partial split: 50 units via air (~48hr ETA after booking) for ~$27,400, or full air (~100 units) for ~$54k. Partial would cover priority customers. Thoughts?

anna_logistics: Partial split is doable. Logistics timeline: approval -> airbook -> pickup -> AWB reissue (48hrs). I'll ask for proof of pickup and new AWB. We can route expedited to FRA and stage to DC.

josh_infra: Short-term mitigation: we can soft-throttle non-critical batch jobs and enable local KV cache fallback to reduce peak pressure. Config push required: `kubectl set env deploy/edge-workers SOFT_THROTTLE=true --record` followed by a rolling restart.

elaine_ops: Agree. Also propose enabling a 24hr burst increase on Dedicated pools (if contract allows) to reduce the number of expedited units needed. Ops cost vs expedite cost tradeoff to evaluate.

mike_sourcing: Requesting a quick vote. Approve partial air-expedite (50 units) to protect priority customers? Reply with :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:.

elaine_ops: :thumbsup: approve partial expedite. Protect customer SLAs.

josh_infra: :thumbsup: partial expedite + I'll run the soft-throttle rollout and KV fallback.

rma_bot: RMA ticket auto-created: RMA-77122. Vendor escalation contact added: anna@nexasupply.com. I'll attach the updated AWB once vendor confirms pickup.

mike_sourcing: I'll approve the PO amendment now and update the procurement ledger with cost center INFRA-EDGE. Anna, please paste the new AWB/tracking when available and ping procurement channel.

anna_logistics: Will do. Also requested vendor to confirm invoice correction and resend commercial invoice PDF. Will update here when AWB reissued.

mike_sourcing: Quick note for runbook: if vendor can't expedite, fallback plan is: (1) reallocate 30% of backfill from US-west, (2) soft-throttle non-critical tenants, (3) notify affected customers via status page.

josh_infra: I'll prepare the soft-throttle rollout playbook and a one-hour run tomorrow at 03:00 UTC to minimize impact.

elaine_ops: I'll check Dedicated pool contract for 24hr burst and report back within 90 min.

anna_logistics: Vendor replied: 'AWB reissued pending carrier pickup tomorrow 07:00 CET. New AWB will be posted to portal.' Will paste AWB when live.

mike_sourcing: Great — thanks team. I'll close procurement loop once AWB lands and charge to INFRA-EDGE.
